elements.title: Display blink patterns
elements.text: Steady: normal. One blink: low battery. Fast blinking: system fault, stop riding.
elements.notes: Two blinks followed by a pause means the speed sensor signal is lost. Check the magnet on the rear wheel before replacing any parts. Three blinks mean the battery needs a firmware update.

elements.title: Before the customer leaves
elements.text: Lock the battery and hand over both keys. Confirm the display shows no warning.
elements.notes: Take a photo of the bike and attach it to the work order.
